title: Paeonol ameliorates postmenopausal hyperlipidemia by inhibiting COX-2 to suppress GRP78-mediated endoplasmic reticulum stress.
authors: Yang, Yulong; Hu, Hanmeng; Yan, Jinjin; Liu, Yarong; Shi, Xiaoyan; Wu, Hongfei; Dai, Min
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹皮酚通过抑制COX-2/GRP78通路改善绝经后高脂血症，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Paeonol (Pae), a primary bioactive constituent of the root of Paeonia suffruticosa Andrews, shows therapeutic potential for postmenopausal hyperlipidemia. Ovariectomized ApoE(-/-) mice fed a high-fat diet and HepG2 cells with palmitate-induced steatosis were employed to evaluate the effects of Pae on lipid metabolism and elucidate the underlying mechanisms. Integrated computational and biophysical approaches established cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) as a high-affinity target of Pae, evidenced by a high molecular docking score (-6.3 kcal/mol), stable binding dynamics in molecular dynamics simulations, and direct target engagement, confirmed through a cellular thermal shift assay (DeltaTm = + 4.2  degrees C). Pae treatment (200 and 400 mg/kg) significantly reduced hepatic lipid accumulation, the liver/body weight ratio, and serum levels of total cholesterol, triglycerides, and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol levels, showing with efficacy comparable to that of 17beta-estradiol. Mechanistically, Pae alleviated lipid accumulation by inhibiting COX-2, an upstream regulator that drives endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) via upregulation of the key sensor glucose-regulated protein 78 (GRP78). This COX-2/GRP78 axis further modulated the unfolded protein response (UPR), evidenced by the coordinated downregulation of key UPR transcription factors spliced X-box binding protein 1 and activating transcription factor 4 following Pae treatment in vivo and in vitro. Genetic silencing of COX-2 reproduced the therapeutic effects, confirming its role in the ERS/UPR network. Importantly, fulvestrant blockade experiments confirmed that this axis functioned is independently of estrogen receptor signaling. These results demonstrate that Pae alleviates postmenopausal hyperlipidemia by targeting the COX-2/GRP78-mediated ERS/UPR cascade, offering a promising estrogen receptor-independent alternative to hormone replacement therapy.
abstract_zh: 丹皮酚（Pae）是牡丹（Paeonia suffruticosa Andrews）根部的主要生物活性成分，对绝经后高脂血症显示出治疗潜力。本研究采用去卵巢ApoE(-/-)小鼠喂食高脂饮食及棕榈酸诱导脂肪变性的HepG2细胞，评估Pae对脂质代谢的影响并阐明其潜在机制。综合计算与生物物理方法确定环氧合酶-2（COX-2）为Pae的高亲和力靶点，证据包括高分子对接评分（-6.3 kcal/mol）、分子动力学模拟中的稳定结合动力学，以及通过细胞热位移实验（ΔTm = +4.2°C）确认的直接靶点结合。Pae处理（200和400 mg/kg）显著减少肝脏脂质积累、肝/体重比及血清总胆固醇、甘油三酯和低密度脂蛋白胆固醇水平，其疗效与17β-雌二醇相当。机制上，Pae通过抑制COX-2缓解脂质积累，COX-2是驱动内质网应激（ERS）的上游调节因子，通过上调关键传感器葡萄糖调节蛋白78（GRP78）实现。该COX-2/GRP78轴进一步调节未折叠蛋白反应（UPR），证据为Pae处理在体内和体外均协同下调关键UPR转录因子剪接型X盒结合蛋白1和激活转录因子4。COX-2的基因沉默重现了治疗效果，确认其在ERS/UPR网络中的作用。重要的是，氟维司群阻断实验证实该轴功能独立于雌激素受体信号。这些结果表明，Pae通过靶向COX-2/GRP78介导的ERS/UPR级联反应缓解绝经后高脂血症，为激素替代疗法提供了一种有前景的雌激素受体非依赖性替代方案。
